name: In Your Face (Combat)
body:
You do not fear to fly in the face of much larger opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Shibaten, quackitude racial trait.

Benefit(s): You count as one size category larger, but only for the purpose of which creatures you can target with combat maneuvers. This does not change your size modifier to CMB or CMD.
